description: Declared mutants of the naming guard (rebuild-naming N17, naming DI 1). The guard is tests/common/naming/naming_guard.py (ctest naming.guard, naming.guard_selftest); its text reading is tests/common/support/source_text.py. ids nm- were added by v8-arch-gyo2-namespace-root; ks-n1-*, ks-real-old-namespace, or-guard-* and wt-guard-real-* were moved here from the kernel, orchestration and world_time lists by v8-arch-gyo2-naming-cleanup, ids kept (the guard used to sit with the kernel tests). A self-test mutant is killed only when the named test case fails; a real-tree mutant when the guard prints the named finding. The adversarial check and the design review (another model, read-only) are recorded in the dev_logs.
